thread:
nora_marketing: Heads-up team  assembling a short KPI readout for Monday execs focused on the launch-posts + webinar combo. Need final MQLs, influenced pipeline, and a one-line note on routing impact by 3pm PT.

ev an_analytics: Pulling now. Raw snapshot: MQLs = 301 (webinar 168, launch posts 87, paid social 46). Avg CTR launch posts 2.4%. Influenced pipeline preliminary ~$410k. Will run reconciliation.

mica_growth: Thanks. Any late-routing noise? Sales said a few leads landed after the 24h window.

tara_ops: We saw a brief SFDC write pause 2026-03-19 10:12-10:37 PT; about 15% of events queued. Backoff + replay applied, ticket #eng-sre-4999. Recon in progress.

kevin_sales: AEs reported 5 leads >36h late, which shifted some demo slots. Would like this called out as "seller friction."

ev an_analytics: After reconcile: net MQLs 295 (dedupe and delayed ingestion adjustments). Influenced pipeline final $397k. Mismatch vs raw <2%.

nora_marketing: Good. Also want a tiny sensitivity table showing how attribution window changes webinar credit (7d vs 21d vs 28d). Evan, can you do that?

ev an_analytics: Quick calc: compared to 7d, 21d increases webinar-attributed pipeline by ~47%, 28d by ~61%. I'll add a small table and the SQL I used.

[SQL]
SELECT date_trunc('day', registered_at) as cohort, source, count(*) AS regs
FROM leads
WHERE registered_at >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1 DESC;

nora_marketing: Slide owners: Evan metrics + appendix, Mica narrative, Tara ops note, Kevin seller impact bullet. Exec one-liner draft: "Webinar drove the largest visible pipeline; widening attribution window increases credited impact materially; minor routing delays introduced seller follow-up friction." Thoughts?

mica_growth: Clean. I'll craft the three wins / three risks slide. Wins = webinar attendance, launch-post CTR steady, paid social efficiency. Risks = attribution sensitivity, routing lag, messaging A/B lift limited.

tara_ops: Reconcile finished at 10:45 PT, mismatch <0.7%. Hotfix ticket closed.

kevin_sales: Adding seller note for appendix about delayed follow-ups impacting booking rate.

pipeline_bot: Slide deck uploaded: https://drive.redwood/marketing/kpi-microbrief-1799990000. Hotfix #eng-sre-4999 resolved.

nora_marketing: Great work. Final: please drop the slide deck link in calendar invite. See you at the 3:30pm review. :thumbsup:
